about: Named viewpoints for tools/review/render.py. Roblox coordinates in studs (Y up; the game's North is +Z, so +X is West). pos = camera, look = point looked at, fov = VERTICAL field of view in degrees (Roblox Camera.FieldOfView convention; Roblox default 70). aboveGround: pos.y and look.y are heights above the terrain (World/Height) under each point. groups: what is drawn (town = Workspace.Town parts, terrain = boot terrain heightfield + river water, editor_ground = build/EditorGround.rbxm, lineup / lineup_ground = placeholder puppets on a 1-stud checker). up: optional camera up vector (used for straight-down views). debug views render only with --debug. optIn views ("optIn": "backdrop", the bd_ views) render only with --set backdrop or when named in --only; their "light" block sets the sun, sky, haze and Neon strength for that view (tools/review/backdrop_render.py).

views.name: a_street_level
views.desc: Eye height 5 st (human head) on the east sidewalk of rd_004 (x = -450), looking north past outer homes 01/02 (left) and 00 (right).

views.name: b_squirrel_eye
views.desc: Squirrel eye 0.8 st above the road surface on rd_001 (x = 0), looking north toward the old-town core trees (Tree_550 at x 25 z -267, Tree_220 / Tree_231 at the core).

views.name: c_tree_25
views.desc: Tree_283 (trunk foot about x -364 z -299, 56 x 76 x 65 st) from 25 st away, eye 5 st, sun behind the camera.

views.name: c2_tree_whole

views.name: d_poles_lamps

views.name: d2_pole_base
views.desc: Close-up of a telephone pole foot and a lamp post foot (Pole_50 at x 125 z -41.2; the export measures every pole 0.95 st above the terrain).

views.name: d3_pole_top
views.desc: A telephone pole top with its crossarm from below (wires would hang here).

views.name: e1_aerial_300

views.name: e2_top_300

views.name: e3_overview_top
views.desc: Whole town straight down from 3600 st, North up (compare with assets/placeholders/town_map.svg).

views.name: f1_lineup_all

views.name: f2_lineup_small

views.name: f3_lineup_rear

views.name: g_editor_view
views.desc: What Studio's EDITOR shows: the town without terrain plus build/EditorGround.rbxm (the server swaps it for terrain at boot).

views.name: h_quay_bridge
views.desc: The quay: stone bridge over the river at x 2125 z 0, bridge towers, embankment (from the west bank, looking east toward -X).

views.name: i_hospital
views.desc: Hospital front (hospital_main x -890 z 882.5, porte cochere, ambulance bay) from the south-west.

views.name: k_gas_canopy
views.desc: East fuel canopy (east_fuel_canopy x 1190 z 157.5) and fuel market at eye height.

views.name: l_treehouse
views.desc: The outer treehouse (floor y 36.6 at x -355 z 385) and the tree it should sit in (Tree_928).

views.name: m_backyard
views.desc: Old-town core back yards at eye height: trampoline with its rail (Fence_19 at y 14.9), garden plots, guest cottage.

views.name: n_quay_street
views.desc: Street level on the Quay promenade (game-west bank, between the river and the east quay row) looking at the stone bridge: banks, embankment walls, arches, deck, towers, parapets.

views.name: o_lamp_close
views.desc: A street lamp close up (rd_010 R31 at x 81.5 z 24.3): vertical dark post on the verge, base, curved arm and head over the kerb.

views.name: p_outer_homes
views.desc: Outer homes with their gable roofs (outer_home_05 at x 155 z -520) from the street.

views.name: q_willow
views.desc: A Quay willow (QUAY WILLOW trunk at x 1787.5 z -70): trunk and drooping crown.

views.name: bd_n_ocean_beach
views.desc: Backdrop: street level on the long beach (eye 5.5 st) looking north over the sea: the pier north of Sycamore Park, the horizon.

views.name: bd_s_plains_mountains
views.desc: Backdrop: street level south of the estates (eye 5.5 st) looking south: plains, hedgerows, the distant road, foothills (R1), mountains (R2), snowy peaks (R3), fog cards between them.

views.name: bd_e_tower
views.desc: Backdrop: street level at the east edge of town (eye 5.5 st) looking -X along the sunset azimuth at the radio tower on its knoll.

views.name: bd_w_offroad
views.desc: Backdrop: street level in the off-road back field (eye 5.5 st) looking +X past the world edge: band terrain, plains, the foothills' arm and the coast.

views.name: bd_marina
views.desc: Backdrop: the marina at the Willow River mouth from the beach (eye 12 st): breakwaters, pontoons, moored boats, harbour lights, the lighthouse beyond.

views.name: bd_mountains_tele
views.desc: Backdrop: the ranges from the sky-lift hilltop (eye 8 st, 40 degree lens): layered foothills, mountains and snowy peaks with fog cards.

views.name: bd_aerial300_s
views.desc: Backdrop: drone at 300 st over the town centre looking south (mountains side).

views.name: bd_aerial300_n
views.desc: Backdrop: drone at 300 st over the old town looking north: beach, pier, marina, ocean horizon (the horizon must read with no seam).

views.name: bd_sunset
views.desc: Backdrop: sunset approximation (sun about 2 degrees up on the measured azimuth) from the north-east of town at eye 6 st: the tower silhouetted against the low sun.

views.name: bd_night
views.desc: Backdrop: night approximation (moonlight, dark sky, Neon lamp heads, tower beacon, lighthouse and harbour lights) from the drone at 300 st looking -X toward the tower.

views.name: bd_overview
views.desc: Backdrop: the whole bay from 9 km up and 12 km south: town, band terrain, land mesh, ranges, fog cards, coast and ocean.

views.name: axes_check
views.desc: Orientation test: red +X, green +Y, blue +Z bars from the origin, a WedgePart at (-4,1,0) (tall face at its +Z), a cylinder at (0,1,-5) (axis X) a ball at (-4,1,-5) and two black Beam wires (wedge top -> ball top, green bar top -> ball top). From (+X,+Y,+Z) a correct render shows red going down-RIGHT and blue going down-LEFT.
